name: The Husk of Deskari (13-14)
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-19: What Walks Again

items.name: Scythe
items.description: Derived from a farming tool used to mow down long grains and cereals, this weapon has a long wooden shaft with protruding handles, capped with a curved blade set at a right angle.

generalAbilities.name: Locust Horde
generalAbilities.description: Once the Husk of Deskari has been reduced to 200 hp the surviving locusts retreat inside the Husk rather than surrounding it. At this point the Disgorge Swarm aura ceases to function, the Husk loses its weakness to splash effects and area of effect attacks, and any creature still taking persistent damage from this effect automatically succeeds on their next flat check to remove it.

defensiveAbilities.name: All-Around Vision
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

This monster can see in all directions simultaneously and therefore can't be flanked.

defensiveAbilities.name: Cacophony
defensiveAbilities.description: The droning buzz of locusts fills the air and mingles with the rasping, screeching sounds of the Husk's carapace plates grinding as it moves. Any creature that begins its turn or moves within 60 feet of the Husk of Deskari must attempt a DC 37 Fortitude Saving Throw save or be Sickened 1. After attempting the save a creature is immune to the effects of cacophony for 1 minute. On a critical failure, a creature is only immune for 1 round.

defensiveAbilities.name: Reactive Strike (Stinger Only)
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Disgorge Swarm
offensiveAbilities.description:
Millions of fiendish locusts swarm out of the Husk of Deskari, surrounding it in a 30ft Type:emanation. The swarm moves with the Husk and remains until removed by Locust Horde. Any creature that enters or begins its turn in the emanation must attempt a DC 37 Reflex Saving Throw save, with effects based on the results of the save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes 2d8 Piercing Damage damage and is Clumsy 1 for 1 round.

Failure The creature takes 4d8 Piercing Damage damage and is clumsy 1 for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature takes 8d8 Piercing Damage damage and is Clumsy 2 for one minute.

offensiveAbilities.name: Swarmsense
offensiveAbilities.description: The Husk of Deskari can see through the eyes of each insect in the swarms infesting its body or those created by its breath weapon. This grants the Husk of Deskari All-Around Vision.

offensiveAbilities.name: Knockdown
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Knockdown in its damage entry

Effect The monster attempts to Trip the creature. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the monster's multiple attack penalty.
